**Article Details for PMID: 29357392**

**Title:** Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults: Synopsis of the 2017 American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association Hypertension Guideline.

**Authors:** Robert M Carey, Paul K Whelton, 2017 ACC/AHA Hypertension Guideline Writing Committee

**Journal:** Annals of internal medicine
**Publication Date:** 2019-01-03
**DOI:** 10.7326/M17-3203

**Abstract:**
In November 2017, the American College of Cardiology (ACC) and the American Heart Association (AHA) released a clinical practice guideline for the prevention, detection, evaluation, and treatment of high blood pressure (BP) in adults. This article summarizes the major recommendations.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
